secrets.title: Secret Woods
secrets.how: Cut the fallen log at the south end of Cindersap Forest with a Steel Axe (Level 1+). Inside: Hardwood ×6 daily, Woodskip fish pond, and Old Master Cannoli statue.

secrets.title: Old Master Cannoli
secrets.how: In the Secret Woods, place a Sweet Gem Berry on the stone statue. Sweet Gem Berry grows from Rare Seeds (Traveling Merchant, 1,000–2,500g).

secrets.title: Witch's Swamp
secrets.how: Complete the Dark Talisman quest (from Krobus in the Sewers after 60 Museum donations). Enter the witch's hut for void items and hat events.

secrets.title: Wizard's Loft
secrets.how: Reach 4 hearts with the Wizard. His cellar unlocks — contains magical furniture and explains the forest spirits (Junimos).

secrets.title: Artifact Spots
secrets.how: Watch for worm-like tiles sticking out of the ground. Dig with your Hoe for artifacts, mixed seeds, or Ancient Seeds. Ancient Seeds → Ancient Fruit = best crop.

secrets.title: Traveling Merchant
secrets.how: She parks south of your farm every Monday and Friday. Sells Rare Seeds, Coffee Beans, and rare furniture. Budget 2,000–5,000g to spend each visit.

secrets.title: Frog in the Rain
secrets.how: On a rainy day, enter the Sewers. There's a frog that asks for a specific item from your inventory. Give it and you'll be told helpful game lore.

secrets.title: Hat Mouse
secrets.how: If any of your animals die, a mouse appears in the lower right of your farmhouse. Trade in-game hats for unique items.

secrets.title: Ginger Island
secrets.how: Repair Willy's boat (200 Hardwood + 5 Battery Packs + 5 Iridium Bars). Opens Year 2+ typically. A whole new map with crops, fossils, and the Volcano Dungeon.
secrets.reward: Island Farm, Volcano, Golden Walnuts, Qi's Room

secrets.title: Desert Obelisk (Qi's Challenge)
secrets.how: Send a Prismatic Shard to the golden box at the bottom of the mine. Mr. Qi contacts you and sends you to Qi's Walnut Room (Ginger Island). Spend Golden Walnuts here.
secrets.reward: Qi Gems, Perfection Tracker, exclusive crops

secrets.title: Stardrop Locations
secrets.how: You can permanently raise max energy by finding Stardrops: Old Master Cannoli, Melanie (8 hearts), Krobus (20,000g), Star Token prize at fair, Museum reward, Willy (legendary fish).

secrets.title: Night Events
secrets.how: Random events happen overnight: Witch visits (turns eggs void/golden), Fairy visits (fully grows a random crop), Meteorite falls (iridium ore), UFO (cow turns purple — gives caviar milk!).
secrets.reward: Varies — big buffs if you're lucky!

secretNotes.title: Buried Treasure Map I
secretNotes.where: Near south side of farm or town
secretNotes.reward: Dig with Hoe at the marked X for a chest (500–1,000g or rare item).

secretNotes.title: Old Mariner's Hint
secretNotes.reward: Reveals the Old Mariner appears on the east beach on RAINY days. Buy Mermaid's Pendant (5,000g) for marriage proposal.

secretNotes.title: Buried Treasure Map II
secretNotes.where: Specific dig location shown in image
secretNotes.reward: Dig at marked spot for another buried item chest.

secretNotes.title: Sam's Schedule Secret
secretNotes.reward: Sam plays video games in his room until noon on weekdays. Best gifting window is 10 AM–12 PM.

secretNotes.title: Penny's Diary
secretNotes.reward: A private diary entry about Penny's home life and her dreams of a better future.

secretNotes.title: Path to the Sewers
secretNotes.reward: Rusty Key (60 Museum donations → Gunther) as the key to accessing Krobus's Sewers shop.

secretNotes.title: Sebastian at the Lake
secretNotes.reward: Sebastian visits the mountain lake at night. Visit 8 PM–12 AM for his 6-heart event.

secretNotes.title: Linus's Berry Foraging Route
secretNotes.reward: Shows Salmonberry bush locations across town. Useful for Spring 15–18.

secretNotes.title: The Back Tunnel to the Desert
secretNotes.reward: ⭐ BIG SECRET: Hidden tunnel from bus stop area to Calico Desert — bypasses the broken bus!

secretNotes.title: Dwarf Rune Translation
secretNotes.reward: Cryptic runes related to Dwarvish language. Connects to Dwarvish Handbook.

secretNotes.title: Marnie & Mayor Lewis
secretNotes.reward: Reveals the secret romantic relationship between Marnie and Mayor Lewis.

secretNotes.title: Mixed Seeds Treasure
secretNotes.reward: Dig with Hoe at marked location for free Mixed Seeds.

secretNotes.title: Sandy's Secret Word
secretNotes.reward: Contains code phrase for Sandy's shop. Say it for a secret Easter egg response.

secretNotes.title: Caroline's Tea Garden
secretNotes.where: Closed forest area northeast of farm
secretNotes.reward: Caroline secretly visits a hidden garden with a Tea Sapling.

secretNotes.title: Buried Treasure Map III
secretNotes.reward: Third treasure map. Dig at marked X for buried item (500–2,000g or useful item).

secretNotes.title: Maru and Sebastian's Family Story
secretNotes.reward: Explains tension between Sebastian and Demetrius — makes both 10-heart events more meaningful.

secretNotes.title: Clint's Feelings for Emily
secretNotes.reward: Clint has a secret crush on Emily but is too shy to say anything.

secretNotes.title: Mr. Qi's First Message
secretNotes.reward: ⭐ Begins the Mr. Qi questline! Leads to Walnut Room on Ginger Island.

secretNotes.title: George & Evelyn's Love Story
secretNotes.reward: A touching story about how George and Evelyn met and fell in love.
